title: How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests
abstract: arXiv:2611.10307v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. translated_title: 剩余多少很重要：部分提示污染测试中的假阳性与假阴性
translated_abstract: 部分提示补全是指模型接收基准测试题目的前半部分，然后检验其能否复现剩余部分，这是一种广泛使用的基准污染检测方法。我们使用 MATH-500 以及最新的 AIME 2025/2026 题目（作为真阴性样本）对七个开源权重模型进行了这项测试的审计。记忆化标记强烈依赖于剩余文本的多少：对于每个模型，剩余单词不超过 8 个的题目被标记的频率是剩余单词至少 25 个的题目的数倍（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上为 31.5% 对 5.5%），且所有基于 ROUGE 的标记中有二分之一到四分之三来自较短的剩余文本。在真阴性样本上，ROUGE-L ≥ 0.75 阈值在 60% 前缀时最多会误标 6.7% 的题目，而在 80% 前缀时即使精确匹配也会误标 8.6%（跨模型汇总；在晚于所有模型训练时间的 AIME 2026 上为 6.2%），而 40-60% 前缀时为 0%。该测试还会遗漏上游污染：从 Qwen2.5-Math 蒸馏而来的模型……
tldr: 该论文审计了部分提示污染测试，发现剩余文本越短假阳性越多（短剩余文本贡献了大部分 ROUGE 标记，在真阴性题目上 80% 前缀时误标率高达 8.6%），且该测试无法检测通过蒸馏传播的上游污染。
en_tdlr: This audit shows that partial-prompt contamination tests produce many false positives when little text remains (up to 8.6% false flags on true negatives at an 80% prefix) and miss contamination propagated through model distillation.
